messages:
ana: Quick thread  Product proposing two new buys: PriorityPulse (latency lane) + BurstLocker (prepaid burst bundles). Need launch checklist, pricing pilot shape, and contract guardrails. 30m sync at 4?

liz: 4pm works. One ask: what exactly does PriorityPulse promise vs PriorityPulse Pro? Need customer language.

sam: Product: PriorityPulse = soft-priority routing with documented SLO window; PriorityPulse Pro = reserved capacity + higher SLOs and enterprise routing. BurstLocker = prepaid token bundles that expire monthly unless committed.

mohit: Tech note: soft-priority implemented with weighted scheduler; pro requires pool reservations and scheduler QoS updates. Pilot = soft-priority + token buckets. Infra uplift for pilot ~+18%.

ralph: Commercial idea: paid pilot (30% off) with a short commit (6 weeks) to capture billing signals. Map commit tiers to discounts: small/med/large. Need a commit->discount table for sales.

legal: I'll prepare a Pilot Addendum and a Pro SLA draft. Pilot Addendum should include conversion terms, usage limits, and an abuse clause. Avoid words like "guaranteed" without credits.

ana: @ops-bot please attach last-quarter burst & top-route exports so we can size BurstLocker bundles.

ops-bot: Export uploaded: https://internal.redwood/exports/prioritypulse-toproutes-q4.csv :file_folder:

liz: Quality guardrail: during pilot, any model/quantization variant must keep <5% eval-regression on composer prompts. Also surface a short-runbook for rollover & complaints.

sam: Proposed SLO bands: PriorityPulse p50 <= 20ms, p95 <= 100ms for short interactive prompts; PriorityPulse Pro p95 <= 50ms. Docs must include fallback behavior.

mohit: Router snippet for RFC (soft-priority): ```yaml
priority_mode: weighted
weights:
  prioritypulse: 1.7
  default: 1.0
burst_bucket:
  refill: 86400
  size_tokens: 500000
``` Include this in RFC to speed implementation.

ralph: Pilot commercial terms: 30% off BurstLocker bundles for pilot customers, 6-week min, option to convert with pro-rated credits. Sales wants a simple convert flow.

legal: Also flag export-control and data residency clauses for pilot customers in regulated sectors. I'll add conversion billing language.

ana: Action items:
- ana: set 4pm sync and capture notes + RFC stub
- liz: evaluation prompt set + runbook (EOD)
- sam: commit->discount table + bundle sizing proposal (tomorrow)
- mohit: infra estimate + RFC router snippet in 24h
- ralph: sales convert flow draft (48h)
- legal: pilot addendum + pro-sla draft (48h)
- ops-bot: attach perf traces & usage CSV to thread

sam: Suggested customer-facing wording: "PriorityPulse: prioritized routing with documented SLO bands and graceful fallback. Upgrade to PriorityPulse Pro for dedicated capacity and enterprise SLAs." Keeps expectations clear.

liz: +1. Also put a short note: "Model rollouts may temporarily affect latency/quality; we document rollback & mitigation steps."

mohit: If dedicated pools delay Pro timeline, GA can be PriorityPulse (soft) + BurstLocker. Reserve Pro for later.

ana: Will post RFC link after sync and schedule T+3 follow-up to review pilot contracts and bundle sizing. Thanks all.

ops-bot: Export link: https://internal.redwood/exports/prioritypulse-toproutes-q4.csv (uploaded)
